post_title: How I Built a Business I Can Run From Anywhere
meta_description: Mike Moll on Livin That Life: how process, delegation, and client fit let him run his business from 38 cities in one year.
tldr: The travel came after the systems, not before.
Process, delegation, and client fit are what make it work on the road.
intro_html: Livin That Life is Riley Bennett's show about people who earn while they travel. I came on to share how I run my business from the road. In 2022 I worked from 38 cities across 10 countries. Here is what made that possible.

sections.h2: The freedom came from the boring stuff
sections.html: People assume the travel comes first. For me it came last. First I had to fix the business so it did not need me in one place. That meant a clear process, work I could hand off, and clients who were a good fit. None of that is glamorous. But once it was in place, my location stopped mattering. I could open a laptop in a new city and the business kept running.

I do not run ads to keep leads flowing. I lean on organic reach, referrals, personalized video, and guesting on shows like this one. Then I keep my own time low by delegating the repeatable work and holding on to the few things only I should do. That mix is what lets the money keep coming while I move around. I go deeper on the how on Digital Nomad Stories.

about_blurb_html: Livin That Life, hosted by full-time nomad Riley Bennett, features location-independent entrepreneurs on how they earn and live while traveling. Mike came on to share how he built a business he can run from anywhere.
